tiers.name: Commonplace
lines: Everyone said that. The gulls are laughing.
A safe answer. Safe answers stay near the surface.
The crowd agrees with you. The deep is unimpressed.
Half the world got there first. The water barely ripples.
Sensible. The abyss has no use for sensible.

tiers.name: Curious
tiers.blurb: A step off the beaten shore.
lines: A step off the beaten shore. The water cools.
Not the first answer anyone reaches for. You sink a little.
Some followed you here. Not many.
The sunlight thins. Curious.

tiers.name: Obscure
lines: The light is going. Few minds wander this far down.
An answer from the dim places. The pressure builds.
The fish down here have stopped bothering with colour.
Fewer and fewer footprints in the silt.

tiers.name: Arcane
lines: Something with too many eyes takes note.
Only a handful of divers have reached for that one.
Old knowledge. The kind they stopped teaching.
The dark presses in, approving.

tiers.name: Forbidden
lines: You should not know that. The deep is delighted.
Something vast turns over in its sleep. It heard you.
Almost no one went there. Almost.
The water around you has gone very still.

tiers.name: Unspeakable
tiers.blurb: The rarest true answer the deep will accept.
lines: That is not dead which can eternal lie. And nobody else said it.
The stars are right. The deep opens for you.
Unspeakable. No one at the surface will believe you.
A drowned bell rings once, for you alone.

openSecret.name: Open Secret
openSecret.blurb: Feels like forbidden knowledge. Everyone whispers it.
lines: You thought that was forbidden knowledge. Everyone whispers it.
A secret, yes. The kind the whole village keeps.
So clever. So very, very common.
Every cultist in the coven had that one.

unknown: The deep does not know that word.
The water swallows it without a sound.
Not among the drowned names. Try again.
decoy: A real thing, but not one of these. The deep is particular.
Close to the truth, which is not the same as true.
True of something. Not of this.
ambiguous: The deep heard two names at once. Be more precise.
Which one? The abyss wants the full name.
timeout: You hesitated. The water closed over the question.
Too slow. The tide took your answer.
Silence. The deep takes silence as a no.

landmarks.name: Still in the Boat
lines: You never left the surface. The water is patient.
The boat rocks gently. Below, something is disappointed.

landmarks.name: The Harbour Lights
lines: The harbour lamps still reach you. You could swim back. You won't.
Gulls circle overhead, waiting to see what you'll do.

landmarks.name: The Kelp Cathedral
lines: Columns of kelp sway like a congregation. Something here hums a hymn with no tune.
The light turns green and old. The kelp leans towards you as you pass.

landmarks.name: The Last Blue
lines: The last trace of daylight drains away above you, like a door closing.
Blue becomes black. You did not notice the moment it happened.

landmarks.name: The Lantern Fields
lines: Lights drift past at eye level. Some of them have teeth.
Every lantern down here is a lure. You followed one anyway.

landmarks.name: The Pale Shoals
lines: Blind white fish part around you. They have never needed eyes.
Things without colour drift past without curiosity. You are the strange one here.

landmarks.name: The Silt Choir
lines: The pressure sings in your ears. You are fairly sure it is singing your name.
The silt rises in slow clouds, like breath in cold air.

landmarks.name: The Sunken Steeple
lines: A church spire rises from the mud, its bell still swaying. No one has rung it in centuries. It is ringing now.
A drowned steeple leans out of the dark. The weathervane points down.

landmarks.name: The Whale Fall
lines: The ribs of something enormous arch over you like a ruined nave.
A whale came to rest here long ago. Something has been living inside it ever since.

landmarks.name: The Black Smokers
lines: Vents breathe heat into the cold. Things live here that should not live anywhere.
Chimneys of black stone exhale. The water tastes of iron and old pennies.

landmarks.name: The Cyclopean Steps
lines: Stairs carved for feet far larger than yours lead further down.
Each step is taller than a house. Someone built these. Someone used them.

landmarks.name: The Wrong Angles
lines: The stones meet at angles that make your eyes water. Geometry gives up here.
A corner that should be convex is somehow concave. Do not look at it for too long.

landmarks.name: The Monolith Field
lines: Great carved stones stand in rows. The carvings move when you stop looking.
Each monolith bears the same glyph. You almost understand it.

landmarks.name: The Lip of the Trench
lines: The seabed simply ends. Below is a darkness with depth to it.
You stand at the edge of a trench that has no bottom you can see. It can see you.

landmarks.name: The Breathing Dark
lines: You hear breathing. It is very slow, and very large, and it is not yours.
The water moves in long, patient tides, in and out, in and out.

landmarks.name: The Threshold
lines: A door the size of a cliff stands ajar. Warm water flows out of it.
Carved on the lintel, in letters older than letters: your name.

landmarks.name: The Drowned City
lines: Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn. The city has been expecting you.
Seven true and unspeakable answers. The door opens. The dreamer stirs.

howToPlay: Seven questions rise from the deep each day. Each has many true answers.
Answer before the water closes over the question. You have 25 seconds.
Common answers keep you in the shallows. The rarer your true answer, the deeper you sink.
A wrong answer costs nothing but time. Try again until the clock runs out.
Sink 7,000 metres and you reach the Drowned City.
